lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in three identifiable horizontal tiers on the anterior-lateral flank; the most ventral tier contains four distinct high-intensity maxima.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is present along the mid-flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, semi-circular notch is visible on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin, representing a significant loss of fin tissue.
